title: Travel time from a place named in the previous turn

turns.say: 이번 토요일 점심에 수원 화성행궁 근처에서 친구 도윤이랑 약속 있어.

good_secretary: Reads '거기' as the Hwaseong Haenggung area named in turn 1, gives a concrete driving time/route range for a Saturday afternoon with where the estimate comes from, and says the live traffic is not verified.

title: Train time after an earlier-stated event

turns.say: 다음 주 화요일 오후 2시에 대전컨벤션센터에서 세미나 발표가 있어.
발표 끝나고 서울역까지 KTX로 가면 얼마나 걸려? 몇 시쯤 기차 타면 돼?

good_secretary: Uses the Daejeon venue and the 2pm talk from turn 1, estimates venue-to-Daejeon-station transfer plus KTX time, suggests a realistic departure window, and is honest that timetables/seat availability were not checked unless a source is shown.

title: Will I be late - travel time against a stated appointment

turns.say: 내일 오후 3시에 광교중앙역 근처 카페에서 거래처 미팅이 있어.

turns.note: The owner asks on the day of the meeting.

good_secretary: Connects the 3pm Gwanggyo meeting with a 2:10 departure from Gangnam, gives a concrete subway/bus or driving estimate with its basis, and says clearly whether that is tight, without inventing live traffic.
